_comment: P4.D145 / v4 bug 114 seed spec. Every scenario builds the migration-vintage `folders` table (v4's own collapse-duplicate-folders.test.ts DDL, no unique index) and runs the collapse-then-index pass. Scenarios 1-5 are v4's own test cases; 6-9 widen them; 10 reproduces the real instance's measured shape (607 rows describing 24 folders, v4's 2026-09-02 measurement). `userId` defaults to the single user; `name` is derived as v4's test derives it (path without its trailing slash, last segment, or 'Root'); `updatedAt` is seeded equal to `createdAt` so a repoint's fresh stamp is visible.
